name: Portal
tagline: Ready-made website for window and door companies
description: Portal is a website template for window, door and garage door companies with a showroom, with a hero framed like a window onto a daylit room, two paths for people building a new home or replacing old windows, a product catalogue grouped into windows, doors and installation, a navy showroom section with colour swatches and questions for the adviser, a three-step process with timing on each step, a FAQ with structured data and client reviews with an average rating. Navy, oak and daylight grey with Chivo headings give the website a calm, trustworthy character. Replace the copy, products, timings, photos, reviews and legal pages with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with the photo set in a window frame and a free measurement call to action
Two paths for a new build or a window and door replacement, each with what to prepare
Product catalogue in three groups: windows, doors and garage doors, installation and service
Showroom section with colour swatches, questions for the adviser and opening hours
Three-step process from the first call to installation, with the timing of each step
FAQ on Uw values, dust, delivery, warranty and tax relief, with FAQPage structured data
Client reviews with an average rating
Three product pages: windows, doors and garage doors, installation and service
Projects page with three projects and their scope
Measurement enquiry form with a product choice
